# Productify

> Productify is a free daily habit tracker app for iPhone focused on calm habit tracking, streaks, smart reminders, Habit Duo accountability, AI insights, and habit templates. It is free to download and does not require an account to start.

Productify helps users build and maintain daily routines with simple habit tracking, flexible reminders, streak visibility, measurable goals, and optional AI-powered habit insights.

This file provides a curated index of the most important pages on productifyapp.org for AI agents and language models.

## Product information

- Platform: iOS 15+, Apple Watch
- Pricing: Free to start, optional Pro subscription
- Account required: No
- App Store: Available on the App Store
